not change the test to make it pass. Report it, and note it here.

### MAJOR SITE-02: 5 broken links: the site links to addresses that answer an error

**Why it matters:** A visitor who follows one of these links reaches an error instead of the page promised.

**Likely fix:** Point each link at a page that exists, or bring the page back (or redirect its old address to where it went).

**In this suite:** the link report (LinkReportTest, links.cy.ts) asks each address again; it fails only on one broken since the crawl.

### MAJOR SITE-07: 73 links and buttons on 16 pages have nothing for a screen reader to say

**Why it matters:** A blind visitor hears only "link" or "button", with no idea where it goes or what it does; accessibility law (the ADA, the European Accessibility Act) counts it, and so do automated accessibility audits.

**Likely fix:** Give each one words: visible text, an aria-label, or an alt on the image inside it (an icon link to a cart: aria-label="Cart").

### MAJOR SITE-08: 4 form fields on 4 pages have no label

**Why it matters:** A screen reader announces a field with no label as "edit text", so a blind visitor cannot tell what to type; a placeholder alone vanishes once typing starts. Accessibility audits fail it.

**Likely fix:** Give each field a `<label for="its id">` (each id used once on the page), or an aria-label.

- /en/client-success/client-stories: 1 field: `<input name="client-stories-grey-3-custom-search">`
- /en/lp/cybershield/category: 1 field: `<input name="cat-search">`
- /en/newsroom/all-news-and-press-releases: 1 field: `<input name="global-search">`
- /en/blog: 1 field: `<input name="finder-search">`

### MAJOR SITE-21: The site's own scripts throw 126 errors on 24 pages

**Why it matters:** An error nothing catches stops the script that threw it: whatever it was doing (a form's checks, a cart, tracking) is left undone. Visitors never report it; it is seen only in the browser's console.

**Likely fix:** Open the page with the browser's developer tools, read the console, and fix each error at the line it names.

### MINOR SITE-04: 2 different pages share one title

**Why it matters:** Search results, bookmarks and browser tabs show the title: pages that share one can't be told apart, and a page without one shows its address.

**Likely fix:** Give each page a title of its own that names what it shows (in a single-page app, set it on each route).

- /en/services/data-and-ai/data-services: titled "Drive business growth with data management and artificial intelligence - Atos", shows "Atos Data Services"
- /en/services/data-and-ai: titled "Drive business growth with data management and artificial intelligence - Atos", shows "Data management and artificial intelligence solutions"

### MINOR SITE-15: 1 page has no main heading; 23 pages have several main headings (h1)

**Why it matters:** Screen reader users jump to the h1 to learn what a page is, and search engines read it as the page's subject; none, or several competing, says neither.

**Likely fix:** Give each page one h1 naming what it shows; the site's name in the header is not it.

### MINOR SITE-18: 3 addresses go through a chain of redirects

**Why it matters:** Each redirect is another round trip before the page starts to load, and search engines may give up on a long chain.

**Likely fix:** Redirect each old address straight to the final one, and link to the final address.

- /en/client-success/client-stories/ugap-leveraging-the-move-to-cloud: /advancing-what-matters/en/client-stories/ugap-leveraging-the-move-to-cloud → /en/client-stories/ugap-leveraging-the-move-to-cloud → /en/client-success/client-stories/ugap-leveraging-the-move-to-cloud (301, 301)
- /en/client-success/client-stories/scottish-water-and-atos-partnership-in-action: /advancing-what-matters/en/client-stories/scottish-water-and-atos-partnership-in-action → /en/client-stories/scottish-water-and-atos-partnership-in-action → /en/client-success/client-stories/scottish-water-and-atos-partnership-in-action (301, 301)
- /en/services/digital-workplace/engaged-employee-experience: /advancing-what-matters/en/digital-workplace/engaged-employee-experience → /en/digital-workplace/engaged-employee-experience → /en/services/digital-workplace/engaged-employee-experience (301, 301)

### MINOR SITE-24: 1 security header no page sends

**Why it matters:** Each header closes a door attackers use (a downgrade to http, a script slipped in, the site framed in another to trick a click). Security reviews and compliance checklists ask for them, and they cost a line of server configuration.

**Likely fix:** Add the missing headers in the web server or the CDN (one setting each), starting with Strict-Transport-Security.

- /en/: none of the 278 pages read sends X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors (another site cannot frame it to trick a click)
